name: moss_patch
source: hand-authored fixture — PNW ground decal. 2026-05-18 reauthored — single ground_hug + sparse mote crown, no scatter_7 stalks.

interactions.examine: A patch of moss. Damp, sponge-springy underfoot. Tiny capsule-stalks rise from the surface. Smells of {lex:scent}.
interactions.pickup: You peel a corner of the mat. It comes away with a sucking sigh and leaves a wet print.
interactions.kick: Your boot squelches into the moss. The dent slowly fills back in.
